description:
As a container specialist, you need to audit the configuration of a microservice defined in an INI format. In the directory /home/user/services/configs/, there is a file named microservice.ini containing the following:

[service]
name=auth
port=8081

[database]
host=db.internal
port=5432

Your task is to extract the following data from microservice.ini:
- The service name from the [service] section.
- The port number from the [database] section.

Create an output file at /home/user/services/output/audit_report.txt with exactly the following format (each value on its own line, keys and values separated by a colon and a space):

Service Name: <service name>
Database Port: <database port>

Replace <service name> and <database port> with the actual values found in the INI file.

Ensure there are no extra lines or spaces in the output file. When you are finished, you may display the contents of audit_report.txt to verify correctness.
truth:
Before the task starts:
- The directory /home/user/services/configs/ exists and is writable by the agent.
- The directory /home/user/services/output/ exists and is writable by the agent.
- The file /home/user/services/configs/microservice.ini exists and contains exactly:
[service]
name=auth
port=8081

[database]
host=db.internal
port=5432

After successful completion:
- The file /home/user/services/output/audit_report.txt exists and contains exactly:
Service Name: auth
Database Port: 5432
name: task_000000_14a820e4
